comment: The design of the BUILD face-normal UI test (mitcad#2000; tools/ui-build-face-normal-test.sh): a box standing for an imported machine's leg (F1, its body F1.b0), 40 along X and 60 along Y from (100, 200), 500 high, its bottom face on the XY plane with its centre at (120, 230, 0) and its longest edges along Y. No BUILD part yet: Profile starts with a ground placement. All geometry is synthetic.
